announced on Monday that it had signed a non-binding agreement to acquire a majority stake in Marut Drones.
The deal is valued at approximately $40M.
The phased acquisition would give the company access to Marut's eight DGCA-certified, seven drone pilot training schools and a network of more than 100 dealers across India.
The deal would expand the company's robotics and AI division into India's drone market, projected to reach $11B by 2030.
It will also integrate Marut's platforms with its Raptor300 technology.
The transaction would include upfront consideration, performance-linked payments, and growth capital for Marut.
The transaction remains subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, and regulatory approvals.
Braiin also expects the acquisition to support its Sri Lankan operations, where it has $35.93M in binding contracts and approximately $112M in non-binding MOUs.

title: Braiin targets India's $11B drone market with $40M Marut deal
